# seaweedfs-blueprint

Krateo blueprint wrapping the upstream seaweedfs Helm chart 4.54.0 as a small in-cluster S3 staging store (one master,
one volume server, one filer, the S3 gateway; S3 auth on with identities from a Secret the consumer provides). Published
to oci://ghcr.io/krateo-blueprints/charts/seaweedfs on the blueprints channel, with its CompositionDefinition inside.

## Shape
- blueprints/seaweedfs/chart: Chart.yaml (literal 4.54.0, dependency on upstream), Chart.lock, values.yaml,
  values.schema.json, templates/preconditions.yaml (the S3 identity refusal).
- blueprints/seaweedfs/compositiondefinition.yaml: namespace seaweedfs-system.

## Pins
- Chart.lock committed; krateo.io/upstream-digest is the upstream archive's SHA-256, checked live.

## Defaults
- PVCs on the cluster default StorageClass; logs on emptyDir; no ClusterRole; no resize hook; no ingress.
- The staging bucket mariadb-staging; resource requests and memory limits on every container.
- No HA: staging holds only objects not yet shipped offsite.

## Docs
- docs/index.md, docs/overview.md, docs/usage.md, docs/configuration.md, docs/api.md, docs/examples.md,
  docs/release.md, docs/log.md
